text:
elaine: Heads-up — docs PR #789 needs a reviewer and a merge slot before the v1.5 docs cutoff (2026-04-01). It updates the SDK snippet, adds a migration note for pinned-models, and fixes a few broken links. Preview link: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/PR-789 (build failed last run)

mike: I can take a look today, but CI preview is failing on the site build. Getting a 404 on the sidebar include.

sam: Which include? I saw a broken relative link in the migration guide — it points to ../v1/old-api.md which doesn't exist in the v1.5 branch.

mike: yeah that one. Build log excerpt: `Error: include file not found: docs/includes/sidebar.md`

ty: I think the include was moved in the versioned-nav refactor. Quick fix: change the include path to `docs/_includes/sidebar.md` and the link to absolute `/v1.5/old-api/` for the migration note.

ana: @ana (ops: small note) we need a second reviewer for docs PRs touching migration guides — policy needs two approvals if release notes are involved.

ana: oops meant @ana, sorry

ana: also, the PR updates an SDK snippet in `clients/js.md` — can we confirm the snippet matches the runtime changes?

mike: I ran the snippet locally against dedicated env and it works, just updated import path. I'll add a small inline test.

ana: Great. @elaine can you add the reviewers list in the PR description so it's clear who to ping?

elaine: Done — reviewers: @mike, @sam. Added QA checklist and the release cutoff note.

docs-bot: Preview build started for PR-789 — logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/PR-789/1234

sam: I pushed a tiny fix for the relative link and updated the include path. Re-ran preview job.

docs-bot: Preview build failed (step: site-build) — see logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/PR-789/1235

mike: Looking at logs now, failing step is the mkdocs plugin complaining about duplicate nav entries. That happens when a versioned doc has the same slug as the unversioned one.

ty: We had that on the last release too. Quick workaround: add `slug: migration/pinned-models` to the frontmatter of the new page so it doesn't collide.

elaine: Done — added slug and updated PR. Also added note in the release checklist to verify slug collisions.

docs-bot: Preview build succeeded for PR-789 — https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/PR-789

ana: Two approvals still needed (policy). @sam — can you do a final pass on wording?

sam: Will do in a few. If all good I'll approve and request merge slot.

mike: Approved. Small nit: change `pin` -> `pinning` in the migration header.

sam: Approved.

elaine: Thanks! Requesting merge slot for tomorrow at 09:00 PT to hit the v1.5 doc cutoff. If release team needs different timing, let me know.

ty: FYI: feature flag `new-pagination` will gate the snippet behavior in prod. Docs team should coordinate with release ops to enable the flag after docs are live.

ana: Noted — I'll file a release ops ticket and add flag toggle steps to the release playbook.

elaine: Merge queued. Will monitor post-merge preview and ping if anything flares. :thumbsup:

mike: thanks all.

sam: ack.

docs-bot: PR-789 merged by elaine at 2026-03-28T16:02:00Z. Preview: https://docs.redwood.ai/v1.5/migration/pinned-models/
